title: corn butter spreader
text: corn butter spreader. got these to use at our annual seafood boil that includes corn on the cob.  They worked using regular size butter cubes, however, we did shorten each stick to make sure the pressure top pieces set inside the holder.  I recommend you leave them in the fridge until just before use... if you let them warm up to room temp, we found it kind of a mess.  If the butter were colder, it would have been easier to smooth onto the corn and to dispense using the top pressure lid.  I put them in the top rack of dishwasher after use and the cleaned up perfectly.  It would be a bit messier to wash by hand because of the grease aspect.  My family all voted on these and gave them the thumbs up.

product_metadata.title: Happy Sales Corn Butter Spreader (Set of 2), White

Cover any leftover butter with the included cap to store
